use_case_summary: Customer will embed a chat assistant in their web app for product help, power in-app doc search over product KBs, and run reranking over candidate answers. Need low-latency chat for UX and cost-effective embeddings for search. POC used Hosted API; plan is to move to Dedicated behind VPC for data controls and predictable cost.
requirements_summary: Key reqs: SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML integration with Okta, VPC peering or private endpoints, one-year (minimum) audit log retention with ability to export logs, customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest, deterministic fallback policy to cheaper model variant, latency SLO 95th < 250ms for chat, throughput sustained 40-60 rps. Procurement asks: committed pricing + overage tiers, SLA for latency and uptime.
